SHARED-F-2-S85.title: Consent API and Tool Router Integration
SHARED-F-2-S85.description: Expose consent framework via backend APIs and integrate with tool_router to enforce consent checks before any tool execution that may store or process PHI. Ensure standardized consent status responses and error handling for non-compliant requests.

SHARED-F-2-S86.title: Cross-Service Consent Integration (Lead Capture and Unknowns)
SHARED-F-2-S86.description: Integrate consent framework with lead_capture and unknown_question services to enforce Tier 2 consent before storing identifiable user data and ensure de-identified handling when consent is not granted.
